description: This file defines extension methods for service registration in an ASP.NET Core application, specifically adding application services, JWT authentication configuration, and Serilog logging setup. It configures dependency injection components such as MediatR, validation, AutoMapper, custom security services, and JWT bearer authentication.

classes.name: ServicesExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for IServiceCollection to register application services, JWT authentication, and logging.

methods.name: AddConduit
methods.description: Registers core application services including MediatR, validation, AutoMapper, and custom security services into the dependency injection container.

methods.name: AddJwt
methods.description: Configures JWT bearer authentication, including token validation parameters and event handling for token extraction.

methods.name: AddSerilogLogging
methods.description: Sets up Serilog logging with console sink and attaches it to the ILoggerFactory.
